source.prompt: Instrumental background music for a classic 1990s-style Japanese fantasy role-playing game. The writing and orchestration evoke the golden age of 16-bit console RPG soundtracks (memorable singable lead melody, clear bass line, warm chords, tasteful hall reverb), but the production is high quality, warm and full, recorded with real-sounding instruments. Completely original melody. Battle at the dramatic turning point of a chapter of the story, against a person or creature the heroes have come to know: dramatic, emotional and urgent; the battle matters to the story. A sweeping, passionate melody with both heartbreak and resolve; faster and more theatrical than an ordinary boss battle, but not dark or monstrous. Tempo 164 BPM, 4/4 time, key of G minor. Instrumentation: unison strings and french horns lead, rolling piano ostinato, staccato brass stabs, snare-driven drums, electric bass, timpani, glockenspiel accents. Form: piano and string intro; driving section with brass stabs; section A sweeping string and horn melody; section B emotional bridge where the piano leads and the harmony lifts; section A returns; the last bar leads back to the driving section. Duration: 95 seconds. Instrumental only: no vocals, no singing, no spoken words, no lyrics. Keep one steady tempo and key from start to finish, no fade-in and no fade-out, no long silences; the last bar leads naturally back into the first bar so the piece loops seamlessly as game background music.
